data.name: Woods and Spirits
data.detailed_description:
Woods and Spirits is a co-op psychological survival horror experience set deep inside a cursed forest that refuses to let you leave unchanged. What begins as a fight for food, shelter, and light slowly becomes a battle for your sanity.

Explore dense wilderness, gather resources, craft tools, and build camps to survive the night. But the forest is alive. Spirits watch from the dark, distort your perception, separate your team, and punish every mistake. You will hear things that are not there, see movement where nothing should be, and question whether your allies are truly safe.

Survival is not just about health and hunger. It is about fear, trust, and control. Stay together, adapt your strategy, and resist the horrors that grow stronger the longer you remain in the woods.
______________________

  • Psychological survival horror with escalating mind games

  • Solo or co-op play focused on tension, teamwork, and survival

  • Resource gathering, crafting, building, and base defense

  • Dynamic spirit encounters that stalk, ambush, and manipulate

  • A hostile forest atmosphere designed around dread and immersion
